text: 1.High school graduate or equivalent or above. 2.Applicants must be in good health 3.Over age of 18. Applicant whose age is under 18 needs to submit notarial certificate of guardianship Note: For those who apply for Fall Semester, a copy of HSK Level 3 is required; or they should pass the Chinese Entrance Exam (equal to HSK Level 3) organized by UIBE; For those who apply for Spring Semester, a copy of HSK Level 4 is required; or they should pass the Chinese Entrance Exam (equal to HSK Level 4) organized by UIBE;
